info.title: Regen Network API (GPT)
info.description:
GPT-optimized API for Regen Network. Combines blockchain ledger data and knowledge base search.

**IMPORTANT**: Call /regen-api/summary first to understand available endpoints.

Unified API for Regen Network combining blockchain ledger data and knowledge base search.

## Two API Modules

### 1. Ledger API (`/regen-api/*`)
Query Regen Network blockchain for ecological credits, carbon markets, governance, and staking.
- **Ecocredits** (4): Credit types, classes, projects, batches
- **Marketplace** (2): Sell orders, allowed denoms
- **Baskets** (3): Basket tokens with balances
- **Bank** (5): Accounts, balances, supply, metadata, params
- **Distribution** (4): Staking rewards, validator/delegator info
- **Governance** (4): Proposals, voting, params, community pool
- **Analytics** (3): Portfolio analysis, market trends, methodology comparison

### 2. Knowledge API (`/api/koi/*`)
Semantic search across 6,500+ documents about regenerative agriculture, Regen Network, and ecological credits.
- **Search**: Hybrid semantic search with RRF ranking
- **Stats**: Knowledge base statistics
- **Weekly Digest**: Curated weekly summaries

All queries are read-only.

block_height.description: Block height when data was queried

indexed_at.description: When the KOI data was last indexed (ISO 8601)

verified.description: Whether the link has been verified

open.description: Whether batch is open for additional issuance

BasketBalance.description: Balance of credits in a basket

withdraw_addr_enabled.description: Whether withdraw address changes are enabled

ProposalFull.description: Full proposal details with votes and deposits

capabilities.description: Available API capabilities grouped by category

answerable.description: Whether the query can be reliably answered with available evidence

evidence_summary.description: Summary of supporting evidence found (when answerable)

post.description: Search the Regen Network knowledge base using hybrid semantic search. Returns relevant documents about regenerative agriculture, Regen Network, ecological credits, and related topics. Results include confidence scores and source citations.

question.description: Natural language question or search query

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

intent.description: Query intent for retrieval profile selection (use person_activity for 'what is X working on?')

source_policy.description: Source visibility policy (bounded by auth; internal_ok may be downgraded)

post.description: Query the code knowledge graph for entities (Classes, Functions, Handlers, Keepers, etc.) and their relationships. Supports listing repositories, searching entities, finding module relationships, and traversing call hierarchies.

query_type.description: Type of graph query to perform

entity_name.description: Entity name or search term (for search_entities, related_entities)

entity_type.description: Entity type filter (for find_by_type). Examples: Sensor, Handler, Class, Interface, Function, Keeper

get.summary: Weekly digest - USE FOR 'this week', 'past week', 'recent news', 'what's happening'
get.description: Weekly digest of recent Regen Network activity. Use for questions like “this week”, “past week”, “recent news”, “what’s happening”, or “weekly update”. Returns curated highlights across governance, community, and ecosystem.

post.description: Entity graph query. Set query_type to one of: resolve | neighborhood | documents. Provide label (to resolve) or uri (if already known).

query_type.description: Type of entity query to perform

label.description: Entity label to look up (e.g., 'ethereum', 'regen commons')

uri.description: Entity URI (preferred if known from previous resolve)

data.description: Entity query payload (shape depends on query_type)
